description: The 2026-10-16 card review reported that card-review/workflow.md references reference/state-check-protocol.md, which 'does not exist'. The file exists (1,259 bytes, git-tracked) and is referenced by 57 files. The claim was made without verifying the path. Second unverified negative assertion from a review run the same day (the first being the Citi Sixt enrollment reported as failed when it succeeded).
correction: Before reporting a file or reference as missing, check the actual path. A negative claim ('does not exist', 'failed', 'no match') requires the same verification as a positive one.
root_cause: Negative findings asserted without a confirming check.
